owner_note: Owner (Oct 30): survive first, $1k by Nov 5 is a stretch, never a reason to size up or force trades. Don't chase win rate: one big win pays for many small losses. Cut losers fast (20% stop, break-even stop). After initials at 1.5x, let the runner ride a 35% trail; don't exit it early. Judge rules by after-fees expectancy, not win rate. Trade what's moving. Fees and size are checked in code. Name the blocker in every PASS.
